create_DeepLabCE_standard: create a DeepLabCE loss module with default settings for standard cross entropy loss on all pixels
create_DeepLabCE_hard_mining: create a DeepLabCE loss module with top_k_percent_pixels set to 0.2 for hard pixel mining
create_DeepLabCE_weighted: create a DeepLabCE loss module with custom class weights and ignore_label for imbalanced segmentation
run_DeepLabCE_forward: run the DeepLabCE forward pass with logits and labels tensors to compute mean pixel loss
run_DeepLabCE_forward_with_weights: run the DeepLabCE forward pass with per-pixel weights to apply weighted cross entropy loss
